data: Kenpache de/en, pinned revision, normalized exact-dedup, conflicting labels removed
split: 70/15/15 stratified language:label; stable sha256 text ordering before splitting
baseline: frozen multilingual MiniLM, masked mean pooling, balanced logistic head C=1
stronger: same encoder and baseline head initialization, all layers trainable, 3 final epochs, full train, bf16, AdamW encoder_lr=2e-5 head_lr=2e-4, weight_decay=.01, 10% warmup, linear decay, batch32, max128, inverse-frequency loss
additional: nearest class centroid in frozen embeddings with squared Euclidean distance; train-only majority classifier, neutral class; neither tuned
test: one terminal evaluation after all artifacts frozen; no adaptation afterwards
selection: highest macro-F1; within 0.005 absolute prefer latency then artifact bytes
latency: CUDA, warmup20 independent example, batch1 entire test, tokenization and transfers included, synchronize each text; startup excluded
inference: 128 tokens, nonoverlapping article chunks, arithmetic mean of per-chunk softmax distributions
